questions.stem: 近年來，許多學校已邀請會說原住民族語的部落長輩到校教課。
questions.answer: In recent years, many schools have invited tribal elders who speak indigenous languages to teach classes.
accepted_answers: Recently, many schools have invited tribal elders who can speak indigenous languages to teach at school.
Over the past few years, many schools have asked tribal elders that speak indigenous languages to teach lessons.

questions.stem: 多年來，這些長輩一直期待孩子們能流利說族語的那一天。
questions.answer: For years, these elders have been looking forward to the day when children can speak their language fluently.
accepted_answers: For many years, these elders have been waiting for the day when children can speak the indigenous language fluently.
These elders have long been looking forward to the day when the children can speak their native language fluently.

1.explanation_zh: 「近年來…已」說的是從過去延續到現在的變化，用現在完成式 have invited；in recent years 的 years 用複數。「會說原住民族語的部落長輩」修飾語很長，英文先寫 tribal elders，再用 who 子句 who speak indigenous languages 放在後面（who 指人，動詞配合複數 elders）。「邀請某人做某事」是 invite + 人 + to + 原形動詞。
evidence: 會說原住民族語的部落長輩
1.strategy_zh: 先抓主幹「學校邀請長輩」，再把「會說原住民族語的」改成 who 子句接在 elders 後面；看到「近年來」「已」就用 have/has + p.p.。
hints: 切成四段：近年來／許多學校已邀請／會說原住民族語的部落長輩／到校教課
標的詞彙：recent（近來的，L2）、invite（邀請，L1）、tribal（部落的，L4）、elder（長輩，L2）、indigenous（原住民族的，L5）、teach（教，L1）
句型框架：In recent years, S + have/has + p.p. + 人 + who + V … + to + VR

2.explanation_zh: 「多年來…一直」表示從過去持續到現在而且還在進行，用現在完成進行式 have been looking forward to（也可寫 have long looked forward to）。「期待」用 look forward to，to 是介系詞，後面接名詞 the day。「孩子們能流利說族語的那一天」整串修飾「那一天」，英文先寫 the day，再用關係副詞 when 帶出子句；修飾動詞 speak 要用副詞 fluently。
2.strategy_zh: 「…的那一天／…的地方／…的原因」先寫名詞，再看子句缺什麼：缺時間用 when、缺地點用 where、缺原因用 why。
hints: 切成四段：多年來，這些長輩一直／期待／孩子們能流利說族語／的那一天
標的詞彙：elder（長輩，L2）、look forward to（期待，L2）、day（日子，L1）、child（孩子，L1）、fluently（流利地，L4）、language（語言，L1）
句型框架：For years, S + have been + V-ing … the day + when + S + can + VR …

references: In recent years, many schools have invited tribal elders who speak indigenous languages to teach classes.
Recently, many schools have invited tribal elders who can speak indigenous languages to teach at school.
Over the past few years, many schools have asked tribal elders that speak indigenous languages to teach lessons.

traps.literal_error: For years, these elders have been looking forward to the day when children can speak their language fluent.
traps.explanation_zh: 「流利地說」修飾動詞，要用副詞 fluently。

2.restructuring_zh: 「孩子們能流利說族語的那一天」整串修飾「那一天」，英文要先寫 the day，再用關係副詞 when 帶出子句補在後面。

1.translation: In recent years, many schools have invited tribal elders who can speak indigenous languages to come and teach classes.
1.explanation_zh: 「近年來…已邀請」用現在完成式 have invited；「會說原住民族語的部落長輩」用 who 引導的關係子句修飾 elders；「到校教課」用 invite + O + to V，譯成 to come and teach classes。

2.translation: For many years, these elders have been looking forward to the day when the children can speak their native languages fluently.
2.explanation_zh: 「多年來…一直期待」是從過去持續到現在的動作，用現在完成進行式 have been looking forward to（to 是介系詞，後接名詞）；「孩子們能流利說族語的那一天」用 the day when 關係副詞子句；「族語」譯 their native languages。

1.translation: In recent years, many schools have invited tribal elders who can speak Indigenous languages to teach classes at school.
1.explanation_zh: 「近年來……已邀請」表示到現在仍有影響，用現在完成式 have invited；「會說原住民族語的部落長輩」用關係代名詞 who 子句修飾 tribal elders。

2.translation: For years, these elders have been looking forward to the day when the children can speak their tribal language fluently.
2.explanation_zh: 「多年來……一直期待」用現在完成進行式 have been looking forward to；「……的那一天」用 the day when 子句，流利用 fluently 修飾 speak。

issues_zh: （建議，不影響判定）「族語」最直譯是 tribal language，第 3 部分 accepted 只收 their language／native language／indigenous language／mother tongue，可補 tribal language。
